tr-b1-vocab-connectors.name: Connectors and discourse markers (B1)
tr-b1-vocab-connectors.desc: B1 connectors and discourse markers for linking ideas — contrast, cause, consequence, addition (ama, ancak, bu yüzden, ayrıca, yani, çünkü).

tr-b2-vocab-law-justice.name: Law and justice (B2)
tr-b2-vocab-law-justice.desc: B2 vocabulary for the legal system, crime, trials, and rights, including verbs (dava açmak, yargılamak, cezalandırmak) and nouns (mahkeme, ceza).

tr-b2-vocab-economy-business.name: Economy and business (B2)
tr-b2-vocab-economy-business.desc: B2 vocabulary for the economy, companies, markets, and finance (yatırım, kâr, yatırım yapmak, kârlı).

tr-b2-vocab-psychology-behaviour.name: Psychology and behaviour (B2)
tr-b2-vocab-psychology-behaviour.desc: B2 vocabulary for personality, emotions, mental health, and behaviour, with verbs and adjectives (üstesinden gelmek, özgüven, bencil, kuşkucu).

tr-b2-vocab-collocations-idioms.name: Collocations and idioms (B2)
tr-b2-vocab-collocations-idioms.desc: B2 fixed collocations and idiomatic expressions in their citation form (karar vermek, göz önünde bulundurmak, aklına gelmek, iyi ki, ne de olsa).

tr-b2-vocab-formal-connectors.name: Formal connectors and hedging (B2)
tr-b2-vocab-formal-connectors.desc: B2 formal connectors and hedging expressions for argumentative writing (dolayısıyla, bununla birlikte, öte yandan, söz konusu, görünüşe göre).
